title: Learning English with Podcasts
subtitle: 考点：学习方法 / look up, aloud, in addition
passage: Lucy wanted to improve her English, so she asked her teacher for advice. The teacher suggested that she listen to a short podcast every day. Lucy tried it. At first, she could not understand everything, so she wrote down new words and looked them up in a dictionary.

After a month, she began to read the stories aloud and copy the speakers' pronunciation. In addition, she made flashcards for difficult words and reviewed them on the bus. Step by step, her listening got better, and she felt more confident. Lucy says, 'Learning is not about speed. It is about finding a method that suits you.'
